prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a parking lot collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1150; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not clear whether all of the damage came from this impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours are far more than the damage needs, about three times a normal estimate.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked across the center, with the left tail lamp housing broken and the trunk lid edge scuffed. Some of the lower panel damage may predate this parking lot impact, and it is not yet clear which marks came from this event. Nothing in the file points to earlier repairs on this vehicle, and the invoices show no duplicated charges. However, the labor hours requested run roughly three times what this damage would normally take. I recommend replacing the bumper cover and tail lamp assembly, refinishing the trunk edge, and returning the labor estimate for a line-by-line review before approval.
